changeSet.comment: Create issue requests table for requests a contractor sends to the tenant about an issue (e.g. asking for additional images)
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS REMSFAL.issue_requests ( issue_id UUID, organization_id UUID, issue_request_id UUID, message TEXT, attachment_ids LIST<UUID>, created_at TIMESTAMP, modified_at TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY ((issue_id, organization_id), issue_request_id) ) WITH CLUSTERING ORDER BY (issue_request_id ASC);
